description: Get the current exchange rate for an asset in a fiat currency (rate = fiat units per 1 whole asset unit, with source provenance). Assets: Btc, Usdc, Usdt, Eurc, Sol, Eth. 161 ISO 4217 fiat currencies are supported. Requires an API key.

asset.description: Asset: Btc, Usdc, Usdt, Eurc, Sol, or Eth

fiatCurrency.description: Fiat currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, SEK

name: get_rate
title: Get exchange rate
